findings.description: Within turkey and soup templates, the correct equation is always uniquely shortest. Three-digit initial readings and two-digit ambient readings preserve this cue, bypassing ambient identification and Newton-law reasoning. All 20 tested cases survive moderate delivery. The requested easy batch does not exhibit this demonstrated shortcut.
findings.reproduction: Run: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 /home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/.venv/bin/python reproduce_failures.py shortest. Exact case: moderate q-106883, seed 92601, S=52, I=179. The RHS choices are -179(T-52), -k(T-52), -52(T-179), -k(T-179), and -kT(T-52). The correct second expression alone is shortest. Complete record and screenshot: shortcut-render-records.json and render-shortcut/question-001.png.
